svg.aria-label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Compression: direct projection and completed groups schematic
svg.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash — Compression: direct projection and completed groups
svg.desc: Keep the direct per-token path separate from learned per-channel pooling. The grouped path carries an incomplete tail explicitly between calls. Authored adaptation of DeepSeek publisher code (MIT). Readable reference before RoPE and quantization; FP32 projection, pooling and normalization arithmetic with input-dtype output. BF16 weights are supported, without emulating checkpoint rounding. Explicit tail tensors replace the publisher preallocated decode buffers; reset state for each new sequence. V41Config fixes grouped compression to the encoder path and supplies the normalization epsilon. Publisher mapping is not production certification.
